review: Reviewed exact source/Core/Smart pair. smart-base and the loader are byte-identical to the previous review, so the Smart base and the loading path did not move. The Smart runtime changed in one place: the checkbox template. Its disabled glyph took --sf-disable, the twelve-per-cent wash that belongs to a fill, and now takes --sf-on-disable; and its checked glyph rule, which painted --sf-on-primary, is now guarded with :not(:has(input:disabled)) so a locked ticked box stops looking like an editable one. Both are declarations inside the template's own stylesheet. No attribute, property, event, slot, nesting rule, cleanup path or asset reference is touched, so none of the eight lessons changes; the templates-and-assets lesson still describes the same template file and the same single asset.
